title: The 2nd Range Operations Squadron, PANDA BCU EVAL Service
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.SPACE SYSTEMS COMMAND.FA4610 30 CONS PK
detail_text: The 2nd Range Operations Squadron, Vandenberg SFB CA intends to issue a sole-source procurement action to provide evlaution service for a Panda BCU. The applicable NAICS for this acquisition is 334511, manufacturing of search, detection, navigation, guidance, aeronautical, and nautical systems and instruments with a business size standard of 1350 employees. The proposed contract is for items for which the Government intends to solicit and negotiate with only onesource under the Authority of RFO Part 6.103-1. This is a notice of intent to award a sole source procurement action and is not a request for competitive proposals. However, the Government will consider all proposals received within 30 days of publication of this Special Notice.Firms who want to challenge the sole source must submit an interest letter that demonstrates your firm's ability to provide an equivalent supply as described above. Interested parties must provide a rationale as to why they should beconsidered. Respond to the below point of contact referencing F4D1R36076AW01 by 14 May 2026, 12 p.m. (PST). A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed contract action based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. The 30th Contracting Squadron will not reimburse for any costs connected with providing capability information. If you have any questions, please contact Chris Hummel, Contracting Officer or Moses Fores, Contracting Specailist, 30th Contracting Squadron, 1515 Iceland Ave, Room 150, Vandenberg SFB CA 93437-5212, email: christopher.hummel.6@spaceforce.mil or moises.flores.1@spaceforce.mil
